{{Quote|We must persevere. We are the Republic!|Excerpt from one of the ship's final logs|<ref name="SWTOR" />}}
The '''''Tanthior''''' was a [[Hammerhead-class cruiser|''Hammerhead''-class cruiser]] in service to the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] during the [[Eternal Empire conquest|war with Zakuul]].<ref name="SWTOR" />

==History==
At some point during the [[Zakuul]]an [[Eternal Empire]]'s [[Eternal Empire conquest|conquest]] of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]], the ''Tanthior'' was sent to join a Republic fleet in a counter-attack against the Zakuulans' advance. However, the rendezvous point had been compromised and the ship was damaged en route, resulting in the loss of part of its forward hull and causing injuries to the crew. This, combined with dwindling fuel and supplies caused unrest which led to a mutiny. The crew seized the galley and the armory, and the original [[Captain/Legends|captain]] was overthrown. The new "captain" then sold the ship to the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutts]]. Some time later, the stolen warship would be used to transport wild beasts. During one such trip, the faulty hull repair caused at least one of the beasts to escape, [[Death/Legends|killing]] the crew and causing to ship to crash-land on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Onderon/Legends|Onderon]], where it would remain. At some point during the [[third Galactic War]], the ship's wreckage was discovered, and the [[Eternal Alliance]]'s [[Alliance Commander|commander]] would later recover the ship's logs.<ref name="SWTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
The ''Tanthior'' appears as the subject of the repayable side mission "Combing the Wreckage" in the [[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Onslaught|''Onslaught'']] expansion for ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''. In it, the player recovers the ship's logs. It is the game's first appearance of a ''Hammerhead''-class cruiser that was in service within the game's timeframe, with the only other ''Hammerhead'' seen at the time, the ''[[Endar Spire]]'', having [[Attack on the Endar Spire|crashed]] [[3956 BBY|over three centuries prior]] to the events of the game. However, several ''Hammerheads'' appear in service in the novel ''[[The Old Republic: Annihilation]]'', set during the [[Galactic War]]. Ships of this class also appeared later in the comic [[Knight Errant 2|''Knight Errant: Aflame'' 2]], as well as the novel ''[[Darth Bane: Path of Destruction]]'', both set over 2,500 years later, supporting continuous use.

References to the damaged hull section were likely due to an error pointed out to creative director [[Charles Boyd]] on twitter, where it was noted the ship had two top halves.<ref>{{Twitter|Charles_Boyd|status/1171493368737619968|[[Charles Boyd]]|quote=But I'm sure a story could be spun about the Tanthion's final owners repairing damage to the lower half with salvaged hull from another Hammerhead they bought sight-unseen, only to realize it was the wrong half upon delivery. This kind of stuff makes great codex material ;)|archivefile=File:Boyd_Tanthior.png}}</ref> He also stated the ship likely had a modified armament.<ref>{{Twitter|Charles_Boyd|status/1171491289247862787|[[Charles Boyd]]|quote=The Tanthion has a fairly complicated history that comes to light in one of the missions on Onderon, so it's not too crazy that it'd have modified/non-standard armament.|archivefile=File:Boyd_Tanthiorhistory.png}}</ref>
